summary: __thiscall getter that reads two dword fields of the object (this+0x4 and this+0x8) and writes them through two independent output pointers a2 and a3. Each output pointer is individually null-guarded, so a null pointer causes that field to be skipped. Returns a3.

operations.description: Guard a2: only write the first field when the output pointer a2 is non-null.
Copy the dword at this+0x4 into *a2.
Guard a3: only write the second field when the output pointer a3 is non-null.
Copy the dword at this+0x8 into *a3.
Return the a3 output pointer as the function result.
